messages:
Lina (CS): Quick summary from NovaCon dry-run: three immediate blockers that the customer flagged as a renewal risk — CIDR overlap, customer CMK denies decrypt, and audit forwarding to their Splunk instance fails with 401. Need owners + P0 triage.
Omar (NetEng): Can you paste the CIDR they want? I'll check overlap and suggest short/long-term options.
Lina (CS): They insisted on 10.10.0.0/16; their on-prem VPN uses the same. They cannot renumber until Q4.
Omar (NetEng): Short-term we can deploy a small translation/proxy pair in our mgmt VPC to avoid route collision (fast, adds ~5-12ms). Long-term: Transit GW segmentation. I'll estimate cost and delivery time.
Pri (Security): KMS: our service saw "AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt". They provided role arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/Novacon-RedwoodBridge but trust policy only allows their internal CI. They must add our service role to trust, and the CMK key policy must grant kms:Decrypt to the assumed role.
Lina (CS): @Pri paste the minimal trust policy we can give them.
Pri (Security): Minimal trust policy (paste to customer, replace REDWOOD_ROLE):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
```
log-bot: Forward attempt 2026-06-02T08:22Z to Splunk HEC returned 401 Unauthorized. Response: {"text":"Invalid token"}. Forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/Novacon-LogPush. See /var/log/forwarder/novacon-2026-06-02.log
Omar (NetEng): For the proxy plan I can have a PoC up in ~6 hours and a runbook for cutover (30-60min window). I'll include latency numbers and rollback steps.
infra-bot: Created ticket CUS-14720: "Novacon priv-VPC blockers (CIDR/KMS/Splunk)" assigned to Omar and Pri. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUS-14720
Theo (CSM): Marking P0 due to renewal risk. Internal sync scheduled today 17:30 PT. I'll loop in renewals/legal.
Lina (CS): Action items: Omar to upload network PoC + cost/latency; Pri to paste exact IAM + CMK snippets and a short verification checklist (assume-role smoke test, kms:Decrypt smoke, Splunk HEC push check); I'll draft the customer note after sync and include owners + ETA.
novacon-contact: We'll update the trust policy and rotate HEC token after your sync. Expect confirmation by 13:00 PT.
Lina (CS): Great — thanks. If we can close these three items before their renewal call next week we should be able to de-escalate. :thumbsup:
